# สมอง BC (BC Brain)

> Dual-audience knowledge base of the BC Ai Account product suite (Thai accounting/ERP for SMEs plus POS, AutoCare, e-Tax, WMS, TMS, Procure, CRM, LINE OA, Market, Dashboard, MonitorMap, WorkMonitor, Company Brain), verified against the real source code.

## Audience Zones (`audience` filter)
- `user`: Plain-Thai guides for end users, Call Center, and pre-sale assistants (`playbook`, `start`, `howto`, `troubleshoot`, `faq`, `reports`, `systems`, `glossary`, `sales`). No SQL/code jargon.
- `dev`: Technical specifications for developers and coding agents (`dev-playbook`, `schema`, `queries`, `api`, `doctypes`, `architecture`) — table schemas, PostgreSQL `SELECT`/`WITH` queries, `trans_flag` catalog, GL Dr/Cr rules, API/MCP contracts.
- `both`: Shared core map (`root` / `index.md`), included in both `"user"` and `"dev"` filters.
- `all`: Full knowledge base across every zone.

## For AI agents (MCP)
- MCP endpoint (Streamable HTTP): https://brain.bcsmethai.com/mcp
- Public and read-only: no key or auth header needed.
- Tools:
  - `ask_brain(question, audience?)` — returns top 4 matching notes (`audience`: `"all" | "user" | "dev"`), ready-to-share `Media & Reference Links` (YouTube tutorials + `bcaccount.com` screenshots + website pages via 1-hop topic aggregation), and 1-hop Connected Graph Context
  - `search_brain(query, limit?, audience?)` — BM25 length-normalized Thai + 4-digit menu code + SQL identifier search with `images` and `videos` media arrays attached to hits
  - `find_media(query?, kind?, limit?, audience?)` — returns structured JSON of official screenshot URLs (`https://bcaccount.com/...`), YouTube video/playlist URLs (`PLO9P7tPZLXB0` with `thumbnailUrl` and `embedUrl`), and website pages
  - `traverse_brain(slug, to_slug?, depth?, direction?, relation?, folder?, limit?, audience?)` — follow 18 typed synapse relations (`uses_table`, `writes_table`, `posts_rule`, `has_query`, `exposes_api`, `solves_issue`, `shares_menu`, `implements_code`, `bridges_zone`, etc.) 1–3 hops or find shortest paths (including cross-zone screen <-> code <-> SQL table paths when `audience: "all"`)
  - `read_note(slug)` — full markdown note with `audience`, `youtube_videos`/`images`/`web_pages` summary lines, typed outgoing links, and typed backlinks
  - `list_notes(folder?, tag?, audience?)` — index of notes filterable by `folder`, `tag`, and `audience`
- **Call Center / Sales mode**: Read `read_note("playbook-call-center")` or `read_note("playbook-sales")` first, then ALWAYS pass `audience: "user"`, cite both exact Thai menu breadcrumb paths AND 4-digit menu codes (`1001`–`9070` across 735 screens via `menu-catalog-overview`), include verified screenshot links (`https://bcaccount.com/...`) and YouTube tutorials (`PLO9P7tPZLXB0` via `Media & Reference Links` or `find_media`), and answer in plain Thai without code/SQL jargon. Cite official pricing/support facts strictly from `sales-pricing-packages`, `sales-accounting-partner`, and `sales-support-implementation-contact` (prices exclude 7% VAT and external AI API costs; never invent custom discounts).
- **Developer mode**: Read `read_note("playbook-dev")` first, then pass `audience: "dev"` (or `"all"` when business workflow context is also needed). Follow `dev-rules-accounting-sql` (`NUMERIC`, `COALESCE(last_status, 0) = 0`).
- **Slash Skill (`/bcbrain`)**: Installable skill instructions at https://brain.bcsmethai.com/skills/bcbrain/SKILL.md (handles `/bcbrain`, `/bcbrain dev`, `/bcbrain all`, `/bcbrain setup`, and stateless HTTP JSON-RPC fallback).
